_comment: Stable layer identity. Session IDs are deliberately absent -- they change whenever a session restarts, so the hub resolves a layer to a live session at dispatch time by matching sessionTitle via list_sessions. 'worktree' is the checkout a layer session works in and is where its git state is read from; 'dir' is where that layer's code lives inside the checkout.

hub.role: Control. Receives intent, routes to layers, arbitrates questions.

api.role: Playwright API tests and the contracts they assert against.

ui.role: Playwright browser tests, selectors, page objects.

load.role: k6 load and performance tests, thresholds, scenarios.
